notes: Menu: Library, CD Creator, Launcher, Music Store, Marketplace, Audio Editor, Settings. Launcher and the stores are placeholders for now. Songs play straight into the next one with no gap. Imported file names are cleaned up ("01-georgia-peach" becomes "georgia peach") and numbers set the track order. The artist comes from the files; nothing is filled in by default. Add from zip replaces Import from Untitled. The 3D CD no longer disappears from the viewer when the playlist ends or repeats. Audio Editor no longer starts the FL Studio MIDI link on its own, and its side panel is compact and scrolls. Released projects show just the track count. Download comes before Share. Project rows show the date each song was added. One click selects a song, double-click plays it. Version labels, the row cover and the player bar phone button are gone. Concept player: album covers show on artist pages, each artist has their own page, picture and background. Covers fill their squares, the type picker has no boxes, the lyrics box is bigger, a settings button sits next to credits, and the logo disc turns.

items: Menu: Library, CD Creator, Launcher, Music Store, Marketplace, Audio Editor, Settings. Launcher and the stores are placeholders for now.
Songs play straight into the next one with no gap.
Imported file names are cleaned up ("01-georgia-peach" becomes "georgia peach") and numbers set the track order. The artist comes from the files; nothing is filled in by default.
Add from zip replaces Import from Untitled.
The 3D CD no longer disappears from the viewer when the playlist ends or repeats.
Audio Editor no longer starts the FL Studio MIDI link on its own, and its side panel is compact and scrolls.
Released projects show just the track count. Download comes before Share. Project rows show the date each song was added.
One click selects a song, double-click plays it. Version labels, the row cover and the player bar phone button are gone.
Concept player: album covers show on artist pages, each artist has their own page, picture and background.
Covers fill their squares, the type picker has no boxes, the lyrics box is bigger, a settings button sits next to credits, and the logo disc turns.
Changelog: see what changed in every version from Settings, after an update, and when checking for updates.
Both CD spines now face the front cover, like a real jewel case.
The CD viewer and 3D export show artwork in the exact colours from the editor.
Art that finishes loading while the viewer is open now shows up.
Credits: sxteen ways, trulytamed and all of KGB.
Easier to read everywhere: stronger contrast for grey text, no tiny text.
Cleaner project page: cover, title, one info line and one row of actions.
Folder projects for loose songs and collaborators.
Released or target release date.
Drag projects in the sidebar into any order; type shown under the name.
Export Disc: artwork, 3D CD, tracks and tracklist in one zip.
Replace audio or images and add versions from right-click menus. Double-click a song to play. Ctrl+S saves.
CD creator: project tabs, several designs per project linked to covers, installed fonts work without importing, Shift+drag to stretch, spines editable on the tray card.
CD viewer opens still and facing front. Arial throughout.
Download the FL Studio plugin from Audio Doctor or Settings.
Audio Doctor: reads tempo, key and first beat, converts MP3 to WAV, exports beat-aligned WAVs.
Send to FL Studio from the Windows app.
Uploaded versions keep their file name.
Project gradient setting.
Status column lines up; no remove button on rows.
Export the 3D CD as a GLB with art, animations and print files.
Album grid like Spotify; fixed covers that collapsed in the Windows app.
Settings page.
Under-the-tray artwork.
Artist name shows correctly.
Drag images onto CD panels in 3D and on the print sheet.
Duplicate project and make a sequel.
The disc spins only in the viewer.
Project page cleanup; whole covers in the library.
Change cover art from right-click and from the naming dialog.
Editor controls, credits and in-app updates.
First Windows release.
